mainEntity.name: What documents are provided during project closeout?

acceptedAnswer.text: During project closeout, we provide a comprehensive set of documents essential for future maintenance and reference. These typically include final lien releases, warranties for materials and labor, operation and maintenance manuals for installed equipment, as-built drawings detailing the final construction, and contact information for key suppliers or subcontractors. This ensures you have all necessary records.
